/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- VDR: הצייר (בלי תלות במשחק — אותו קוד בדף הציור) ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
var VDR = (function () {
  'use strict';
  const K = .6, LD = (() => { const v = [-0.42, -0.55, 0.72], n = Math.hypot(...v); return v.map(a => a / n) })(), TOPB = .62 + .38 * LD[2];
  const hexRGB = h => { h = String(h || '#888').trim(); if (h[0] === '#') { if (h.length === 4) h = '#' + h[1] + h[1] + h[2] + h[2] + h[3] + h[3]; const n = parseInt(h.slice(1, 7), 16); return [n >> 16 & 255, n >> 8 & 255, n & 255] }
    const m = h.match(/(\d+)\D+(\d+)\D+(\d+)/); return m ? [+m[1], +m[2], +m[3]] : [136, 136, 136] };
  const lit = (hex, n) => { const l = Math.hypot(n[0], n[1], n[2]) || 1, d = (n[0] * LD[0] + n[1] * LD[1] + n[2] * LD[2]) / l, b = (.62 + .38 * Math.max(0, d)) / TOPB, c = hexRGB(hex);
    if (b <= 1) return `rgb(${c[0] * b + 14 * (1 - b) | 0},${c[1] * b + 17 * (1 - b) | 0},${c[2] * b + 22 * (1 - b) | 0})`; const k = Math.min(1, (b - 1) * .6); return `rgb(${c[0] + (255 - c[0]) * k | 0},${c[1] + (255 - c[1]) * k | 0},${c[2] + (255 - c[2]) * k | 0})` };
  const TRIM = '#4b5058', SEAT = '#5c6067', DARK = '#191c21', GLASS = 'rgba(118,158,188,.6)', BAGC = ['#c2333a', '#2f7fbf', '#2e9e3e', '#e8b92b', '#7a4f9e', '#d9822b', '#3b3f46', '#1f8a8a'];
  const BAGS = { hatch: 2, sedan: 3, prem: 3, sport: 1, suv: 4, mv: 4, pk: 6, van: 10, truck: 0, limo: 3 };
  // the rows (the one structure: m, u forward from the centre, v to the LEFT, z up — W17's) → the doors in the vehicle's frame (world px: u forward, v to the RIGHT, z up)
  // B: {L (px), hw(u) (px), pxM (px per real m), ty, belt (px)}. A row of cars70's first form (x0 / x1 m from the tail) is turned into the same.
  function from70(d, Lm) { const side = d.side === 'rear' ? (d.type === 'lift' && d.hinge === 'front' ? 'T' : 'B') : d.side, uT = x => x - Lm / 2;
    const type = { hinged: d.side === 'rear' ? (d.hinge === 'side' ? 'rear' : 'rear') : 'regular', sliding: 'sliding', lift: 'rear', drop: 'rear', double: 'double' }[d.type] || 'regular';
    const hinge = d.side === 'rear' ? (d.type === 'drop' ? 'bottom' : d.type === 'lift' ? (d.hinge === 'front' ? 'front' : 'top') : d.hinge === 'side' ? 'right' : d.hinge) : d.hinge;
    if (side === 'T') return { id: 'TK', side, hinge: 'front', type: 'rear', at: [uT(d.x1), 0, d.z1], w: d.x1 - d.x0, h: 0, angle: d.angle, bags: d.bags, role: d.role };
    if (side === 'B') return { id: 'TK', side, hinge, type, at: [uT(0), 0, d.z0], w: 0, h: d.z1 - d.z0, angle: d.angle, bags: d.bags, role: d.role, dep: d.x1 - d.x0 };
    return { id: (d.side === 'L' ? 'L' : 'R') + (d.role || ''), side, hinge, type, at: [uT(hinge === 'rear' ? d.x0 : d.x1), 0, d.z0], w: d.x1 - d.x0, h: d.z1 - d.z0, angle: d.angle, role: d.role } }
  function norm(rows, B) {
    const out = [], pm = B.pxM;
    for (const r of rows || []) {
      const d = r.at ? r : from70(r, B.Lm || B.L / pm), side = d.side, s = side === 'L' ? -1 : side === 'R' ? 1 : 0, [au, , az] = d.at, w = (d.w || 0) * pm, hh = (d.h || 0) * pm, U = au * pm, Z = az * pm;
      const o = { id: d.id || '', side: side === 'B' || side === 'T' ? 'rear' : side, top: side === 'T', s, hinge: d.hinge || 'front', ang: (d.angle != null ? d.angle : 65) * Math.PI / 180, role: d.role || '' };
      if (side === 'L' || side === 'R') { const fwd = d.hinge === 'rear'; o.u0 = fwd ? U : U - w; o.u1 = fwd ? U + w : U; o.z0 = Z; o.z1 = Z + hh; o.v = B.hw((o.u0 + o.u1) / 2);
        o.type = d.type === 'sliding' ? 'sliding' : 'hinged'; o.zb = Math.min(o.z1, B.belt != null && B.belt > o.z0 + 2 ? B.belt : o.z0 + (o.z1 - o.z0) * .55); if (o.type === 'hinged' && d.hinge === 'rear') o.hinge = 'rear' }
      else {   // the trunk: the back door (B) or the lid (T) — the bags inside
        o.bags = d.bags != null ? d.bags : (BAGS[B.ty] != null ? BAGS[B.ty] : 2); o.v = B.hw(-B.L / 2 + 2) * .86;
        if (side === 'T') { o.type = 'lift'; o.hinge = d.hinge === 'rear' ? 'rear' : 'front'; o.u0 = d.hinge === 'rear' ? U : U - w; o.u1 = d.hinge === 'rear' ? U + w : U; o.z0 = Z - 2.5; o.z1 = Z; if (d.h) o.v = d.h * pm / 2 }
        else { const dep = (d.dep || .1) * pm; o.u0 = U; o.u1 = U + dep; o.z0 = Z; o.z1 = Z + hh; if (d.w) o.v = d.w * pm / 2;
          if (d.type === 'double') o.type = 'double'; else if (d.hinge === 'bottom') o.type = 'drop'; else if (d.hinge === 'left' || d.hinge === 'right') { o.type = 'hinged'; o.hinge = 'side'; o.sideS = d.hinge === 'left' ? -1 : 1 } else { o.type = 'lift'; o.hinge = 'top'; o.u1 = U + Math.max(dep, (d.dep || .5) * pm) } } }
      out.push(o);
    }
    return out;
  }
  // the seats → the door of each: 0 the driver, 1 the front passenger, 2 rear left, 3 rear right; 'trunk' — the rear
  function doorFor(P, seat) {
    if (!P || !P.length) return -1; if (seat === 'trunk') return P.findIndex(d => d.side === 'rear');
    const side = seat % 2 ? 'R' : 'L', S = P.map((d, i) => [d, i]).filter(q => q[0].side === side).sort((a, b) => b[0].u1 - a[0].u1);
    if (!S.length) return -1; return seat >= 2 && S.length > 1 ? S[1][1] : S[0][1];
  }
  // where a person stands at a door (outside, behind its free edge) and where he sits (inside) — vehicle frame
  function standAt(d, out) { out = out == null ? 5 : out; if (d.side === 'rear') return { u: d.u0 - 9, v: 0 }; const L = d.u1 - d.u0; return { u: d.u0 + L * .3, v: d.s * (d.v + out) } }
  function seatAt(d) { if (d.side === 'rear') return { u: d.u0 + 4, v: 0 }; return { u: (d.u0 + d.u1) / 2, v: d.s * d.v * .35 } }
  const rotUZ = (pu, pz, a) => [pu * Math.cos(a) - pz * Math.sin(a), pu * Math.sin(a) + pz * Math.cos(a)];
  // one vehicle: which ∈ 'pre' (the far side — before the body) | 'post' (the near side, the openings — after it)
  function paint(c, P, x, y, h, open, col, which, o) {
    if (!P || !open) return 0; o = o || {}; const ch = Math.cos(h), sh = Math.sin(h), k = o.K != null ? o.K : K;
    const pj = (u, v, z) => [x + u * ch - v * sh, y + u * sh + v * ch - k * z], ny = (nu, nv) => nu * sh + nv * ch, wn = (nu, nv, nz) => [nu * ch - nv * sh, nu * sh + nv * ch, nz || 0];
    const quad = (A, B, C, D) => { c.beginPath(); c.moveTo(A[0], A[1]); c.lineTo(B[0], B[1]); c.lineTo(C[0], C[1]); c.lineTo(D[0], D[1]); c.closePath() };
    let n = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < P.length; i++) {
      const a = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, +open[i] || 0)); if (a < .004) continue; const d = P[i];
      if (d.side === 'rear') { const near = -sh >= -1e-3; if ((which === 'post') !== near) continue; n += rear(d, a); continue }
      const near = d.s * ch >= -1e-3; if ((which === 'post') !== near) continue;
      // the opening on the body (only on the near side): dark, with the seat
      if (near) { const f = Math.min(1, a * 2.6), ui = d.u0 + .6, uo = d.u1 - .6, v = d.s * d.v, vt = d.s * d.v * .84;
        c.save(); c.globalAlpha *= f; quad(pj(ui, v, d.z0 + .5), pj(uo, v, d.z0 + .5), pj(uo, vt, d.z1 - .6), pj(ui, vt, d.z1 - .6)); c.fillStyle = DARK; c.fill();
        const zs0 = d.z0 + (d.zb - d.z0) * .35, zs1 = d.zb + (d.z1 - d.zb) * .45, us0 = d.u0 + (d.u1 - d.u0) * .12, us1 = d.u1 - (d.u1 - d.u0) * .22, vs = d.s * d.v * .55;
        quad(pj(us0, vs, zs0), pj(us1, vs, zs0), pj(us1, vs * .9, zs1), pj(us0, vs * .9, zs1)); c.fillStyle = lit(SEAT, wn(0, d.s, .3)); c.fill(); c.restore(); n++ }
      const L = d.u1 - d.u0;
      if (d.type === 'sliding') { // outward a little, then back along the body
        const out = Math.min(1, a * 4) * 3, du = -L * Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (a - .15) / .85)) * (d.hinge === 'front' ? -1 : 1) * -1, v = d.s * (d.v + out);
        const A = pj(d.u0 + du, v, d.z0), B = pj(d.u1 + du, v, d.z0), C = pj(d.u1 + du, v, d.zb), D = pj(d.u0 + du, v, d.zb), up = pj(d.u1 + du, v * .97, d.z1), uq = pj(d.u0 + du, v * .97, d.z1);
        quad(A, B, C, D); c.fillStyle = lit(col, wn(0, d.s, 0)); c.fill(); c.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.35)'; c.lineWidth = .4; c.stroke();
        quad(D, C, up, uq); c.fillStyle = GLASS; c.fill(); c.strokeStyle = lit(col, wn(0, d.s, 0)); c.lineWidth = .7; c.stroke(); n++; continue }
      // a hinged door (the front hinge as a rule; 'rear' — the coach door of a long car)
      const th = a * d.ang, fr = d.hinge !== 'rear', hu = fr ? d.u1 : d.u0, du = fr ? -Math.cos(th) : Math.cos(th), dv = d.s * Math.sin(th), nu = fr ? Math.sin(th) : -Math.sin(th), nv = d.s * Math.cos(th);
      const Hv = d.s * d.v, Eu = hu + L * du, Ev = Hv + L * dv, outer = ny(nu, nv) > 0;
      const A = pj(hu, Hv, d.z0), B = pj(Eu, Ev, d.z0), C = pj(Eu, Ev, d.zb), D = pj(hu, Hv, d.zb);
      quad(A, B, C, D); c.fillStyle = outer ? lit(col, wn(nu, nv, 0)) : lit(TRIM, wn(-nu, -nv, 0)); c.fill(); c.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.4)'; c.lineWidth = .4; c.stroke();
      if (!outer) { const m0 = pj(hu + (Eu - hu) * .2, Hv + (Ev - Hv) * .2, d.zb - 2), m1 = pj(hu + (Eu - hu) * .8, Hv + (Ev - Hv) * .8, d.zb - 2); c.strokeStyle = '#30343a'; c.lineWidth = 1.1; c.beginPath(); c.moveTo(m0[0], m0[1]); c.lineTo(m1[0], m1[1]); c.stroke() }   // the arm rest
      if (d.z1 > d.zb + .5) { const tw = .1, E1 = pj(Eu - du * L * tw, Ev - dv * L * tw, d.z1), H1 = pj(hu, Hv * .97, d.z1);   // the window frame and its glass (the top leans in a little)
        quad(D, C, E1, H1); c.fillStyle = GLASS; c.fill(); c.strokeStyle = outer ? lit(col, wn(nu, nv, 0)) : TRIM; c.lineWidth = 1.1; c.stroke() }
      { const th2 = 1.1, sg = outer ? 1 : -1, Fu = Eu - nu * th2 * sg, Fv = Ev - nv * th2 * sg;   // the thickness of the door at its free edge (~10 cm) — the door reads as a door, not a line
        quad(pj(Eu, Ev, d.z0), pj(Fu, Fv, d.z0), pj(Fu, Fv, d.zb), pj(Eu, Ev, d.zb)); c.fillStyle = lit(col, [du * ch - dv * sh, du * sh + dv * ch, 0]); c.fill(); c.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.45)'; c.lineWidth = .35; c.stroke() }
      n++;
    }
    return n;
    // ---- the rear: the trunk lid, the tailgate, the drop gate, the barn doors — and the bags inside ----
    function rear(d, a) {
      const uR = d.u0 - .3, vR = d.v, ph = a * d.ang, dep = Math.max(2, d.u1 - d.u0);
      if (d.type === 'double' || (d.type === 'hinged' && d.hinge === 'side')) {
        const halves = d.type === 'double' ? [1, -1] : [d.sideS || 1];
        hole(() => { quad(pj(uR, -vR, d.z0), pj(uR, vR, d.z0), pj(uR, vR, d.z1), pj(uR, -vR, d.z1)) }, Math.min(1, a * 2.6));
        if (-sh >= 0) bags(d, a, uR + 5, d.z0);
        for (const s of halves) { const W = d.type === 'double' ? vR : 2 * vR, th = ph, du = -Math.sin(th), dv = -s * Math.cos(th), nu = -Math.cos(th), nv = s * Math.sin(th), Hv = s * vR, Eu = uR + W * du, Ev = Hv + W * dv, outer = ny(nu, nv) > 0;
          quad(pj(uR, Hv, d.z0), pj(Eu, Ev, d.z0), pj(Eu, Ev, d.z1), pj(uR, Hv, d.z1)); c.fillStyle = outer ? lit(col, wn(nu, nv, 0)) : lit(TRIM, wn(-nu, -nv, 0)); c.fill(); c.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.4)'; c.lineWidth = .4; c.stroke() }
        return 1 }
      let hU, hZ, pu, pz, s = -1;   // the hinge line (u, z) and the vector to the free edge, closed; s — the turn (up: −1, down: +1)
      if (d.type === 'drop') { hU = uR; hZ = d.z0; pu = 0; pz = d.z1 - d.z0; s = 1 }
      else if (d.type === 'lift' && d.hinge === 'rear') { hU = d.u0; hZ = d.z1; pu = dep; pz = 0; s = 1 }
      else if (d.hinge === 'top') { hU = uR + dep; hZ = d.z1; pu = -dep; pz = d.z0 - d.z1 }
      else { hU = uR + dep; hZ = d.z1; pu = -dep; pz = 0 }   // 'lift' hinge 'front' — the lid of the boot
      const [qu, qz] = rotUZ(pu, pz, s * ph), [nu0, nz0] = d.type === 'drop' ? [-1, 0] : d.hinge === 'top' ? [-Math.abs(pz), dep] : [0, 1], [nu, nz] = rotUZ(nu0, nz0, s * ph), uR0 = d.hinge === 'rear' && d.type === 'lift' ? d.u0 : uR;
      const outer = (nu * sh) * K + nz > 0 === (nz0 >= 0 || nu0 < 0);
      // the opening: the boot's well (from above) or the back (the hatch, the drop gate)
      if (d.type === 'drop' || d.hinge === 'top') hole(() => quad(pj(uR, -vR, d.z0), pj(uR, vR, d.z0), pj(uR, vR, d.z1), pj(uR, -vR, d.z1)), Math.min(1, a * 2.6));
      else hole(() => quad(pj(uR, -vR, d.z1), pj(uR, vR, d.z1), pj(uR + dep, vR, d.z1), pj(uR + dep, -vR, d.z1)), Math.min(1, a * 2.6));
      bags(d, a, uR + Math.min(dep, 14) * .5 + 1, d.type === 'drop' ? d.z0 : d.hinge === 'top' ? d.z0 - 2 : d.z1 - 6);
      quad(pj(hU, -vR, hZ), pj(hU, vR, hZ), pj(hU + qu, vR, hZ + qz), pj(hU + qu, -vR, hZ + qz));
      c.fillStyle = outer ? lit(col, wn(nu, 0, nz)) : lit(TRIM, wn(-nu, 0, -nz)); c.fill(); c.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.4)'; c.lineWidth = .4; c.stroke();
      if (d.hinge === 'top' && d.type !== 'drop') { const g0 = .45, A = pj(hU + qu * .06, -vR * .86, hZ + qz * .06), B = pj(hU + qu * .06, vR * .86, hZ + qz * .06), C = pj(hU + qu * g0, vR * .86, hZ + qz * g0), D = pj(hU + qu * g0, -vR * .86, hZ + qz * g0); quad(A, B, C, D); c.fillStyle = GLASS; c.fill() }   // the rear window in the hatch
      return 1 }
    function hole(path, f) { if (f <= 0) return; c.save(); c.globalAlpha *= f; path(); c.fillStyle = DARK; c.fill(); c.restore() }
    function bags(d, a, u, z) { const nb = Math.min(o.bags != null ? o.bags : d.bags, 4); if (!nb || a < .35) return; const g = c.globalAlpha; c.globalAlpha = g * Math.min(1, (a - .35) * 3);
      for (let j = 0; j < nb; j++) { const v = (j - (nb - 1) / 2) * Math.min(7, d.v * 1.6 / nb), q = pj(u, v, z), bw = 5.5, bd = 2.6, bh = 4.2;   // 55 × 24 × 42 cm on its side, the colours of the baggage hall (S15GR_BAGC)
        c.fillStyle = BAGC[(j * 3 + (o.seed | 0)) % 8]; c.fillRect(q[0] - bw / 2, q[1] - bh * k - bd / 2, bw, bd); c.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.25)'; c.fillRect(q[0] - bw / 2, q[1] - bh * k + bd / 2, bw, bh * k * .9) }
      c.globalAlpha = g }
  }
  return { K, norm, from70, doorFor, standAt, seatAt, paint, BAGS };
})();

// a model without its own row: the same field from the shut lines of C34 (geo dl — the lines the closed body draws), in asset units (x: from the tail ÷ 10, z: asset)
function drRowsFromGeo(M) {
  const X = M.X, f = u => (u - X) / 10, Z = z => z / 10, dl = M.dl || [], z0 = Z(M.gc + M.A(1.4)), z1 = Z(Math.max(M.zBelt + M.A(1), M.zR - M.A(.5))), out = [], both = d => { out.push(Object.assign({ side: 'L' }, d), Object.assign({ side: 'R' }, d)) };
  if (dl.length >= 2) both({ x0: f(dl[1]) + .02, x1: f(dl[0]), hinge: 'front', type: 'hinged', z0, z1, angle: 65, role: M.boxT ? 'cab' : 'front' });
  if (!M.boxT && dl.length >= 3) both({ x0: f(dl[2]), x1: f(dl[1]) - .02, hinge: 'front', type: 'hinged', z0, z1, angle: 70, role: 'rear' });
  if (M.ty === 'van' && dl.length >= 3) out.push({ side: 'R', x0: f(dl[2]), x1: f(dl[1]) - .06, hinge: 'rear', type: 'sliding', z0, z1: Z(M.zR - M.A(1.2)), angle: 0, role: 'side' });
  const zt = Z(M.zTail), dep = Math.max(.4, f(M.uRG) - f(X + M.dT));
  if (M.ty === 'sedan' || M.ty === 'prem' || M.ty === 'sport') out.push({ side: 'rear', x0: .02, x1: Math.min(dep, f(M.r0) * .9), hinge: 'front', type: 'lift', z0: zt - Z(M.A(2.5)), z1: zt, angle: 75, role: 'trunk' });
  else if (M.ty === 'pk') out.push({ side: 'rear', x0: 0, x1: .08, hinge: 'bottom', type: 'drop', z0: Z(M.bed ? M.bed.zf : M.zTail - M.A(4)), z1: zt, angle: 90, role: 'tailgate' });
  else if (M.ty === 'van') out.push({ side: 'rear', x0: 0, x1: .1, hinge: 'side', type: 'double', z0: Z(M.gc + M.A(2)), z1: Z(M.zR - M.A(1)), angle: 95, role: 'rear' });

// the state of one vehicle: open[i] (0 … 1) toward tgt[i] at rate[i] per second
function drState(vid, P) { let S = DOORS.v.get(vid); if (!S) { S = { open: [], tgt: [], rate: [], t: 0, src: 'pl' }; DOORS.v.set(vid, S) } return S }

function drTick(dt, src) { for (const [vid, S] of DOORS.v) { if (S.src !== src) continue; let any = false; S.t += dt;

    if (S.ids && S.ids[i] && o !== S.open[i]) try { window.__TC_W17.doors.set(vid, S.ids[i], S.open[i]) } catch (e) { } }

function drSeqStep(dt) { const s = DOORS.seq; if (!s) return; s.t += dt; const T = DOORS.T;
  if ((s.k === 'in' && PlayerProfile.mode !== 'vehicle') || (s.k === 'out' && PlayerProfile.mode !== 'walk') || s.t > 4) { drSeqEnd(); return }
  const toward = (A, B, f) => { s.x = A.x + (B.x - A.x) * f; s.y = A.y + (B.y - A.y) * f; const dx = B.x - A.x, dy = B.y - A.y; if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) > .5 && typeof personDirection === 'function') { s.dir = personDirection(dx, dy); s.hd = Math.atan2(dy, dx) } };
  if (s.k === 'in') {
    if (s.ph === 'walk') { const f = Math.min(1, s.t / s.tw); let d = f * s.len; for (let i = 1; i < s.path.length; i++) { const A = s.path[i - 1], B = s.path[i], l = Math.hypot(B.x - A.x, B.y - A.y); if (d <= l || i === s.path.length - 1) { toward(A, B, l > 0 ?       s.mv = true; if (f >= 1) { s.ph = 'open'; s.t0 = s.t; s.mv = false; if (s.di >= 0) drSet('PLAYER-CAR', s.di, 1, T.plOpen, 'pl', s.ids); else { s.ph = 'in' } } return }
    if (s.ph === 'open') { if (s.t - s.t0 >= T.plOpen) { s.ph = 'in'; s.t0 = s.t } return }
    if (s.ph === 'in') { const f = Math.min(1, (s.t - s.t0) / T.plIn); toward(s.S, s.I, f); s.al = 1 - f; s.mv = false; if (f >= 1) { s.ph = 'close'; s.t0 = s.t; if (s.di >= 0) drSet('PLAYER-CAR', s.di, 0, T.plClose, 'pl', s.ids); else { s.ph = 'done'; DOORS.seq = null } } return }
    if (s.ph === 'close') { if (s.t - s.t0 >= T.plClose) { s.ph = 'done'; DOORS.seq = null } return } }
  else {
    if (s.ph === 'open') { if (s.t >= (s.di >= 0 ? T.plOpen : 0)) { s.ph = 'out'; s.t0 = s.t } return }
    if (s.ph === 'out') { const f = Math.min(1, (s.t - s.t0) / T.plIn); toward(s.I, s.S, f); s.al = f; if (f >= 1) { s.ph = 'close'; s.t0 = s.t; PlayerPed.x = s.S.x; PlayerPed.y = s.S.y; if (s.di >= 0) drSet('PLAYER-CAR', s.di, 0, T.plClose, 'pl', s.ids); else { s.ph = 'done'; DOORS.seq = null } } return }
    if (s.ph === 'close') { if (s.t - s.t0 >= T.plClose) { s.ph = 'done'; DOORS.seq = null } return } } }

function drClStep(dt) { const T = DOORS.T, L = DOORS.cl; for (let i = L.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { const e = L[i]; e.t += dt; let done = false;
  try { const p = e.p, mv = (A, B, f) => { e.x = A.x + (B.x - A.x) * f; e.y = A.y + (B.y - A.y) * f };
    if (e.k === 'taxi-in' && (e.ph === 'tw' || e.ph === 'topen' || e.ph === 'tput' || e.ph === 'tclose' || e.ph === 'dw')) {   // the suitcase first (a hotel): the trunk
      const TB = T.trunk; if (e.ph === 'tw') { const f = Math.min(1, e.t / TB.walk); mv(e.A, e.TS, f); if (f >= 1) { e.ph = 'topen'; e.t0 = e.t; drSet(e.vid, e.tk, 1, TB.open, 'cl'); drState(e.vid).bags = 0 } }

      else if (e.ph === 'dw') { const f = Math.min(1, (e.t - e.t0) / TB.walk); mv(e.TS, e.A, f); if (f >= 1) { e.ph = 'open'; e.t = 0; e.x = null; e.y = null; drSet(e.vid, e.di, 1, T.clOpen, 'cl') } } }

function econCollect(id,silent){const r=econState().own[id];if(!r)return silent?0:toast('הנכס לא בבעלותך');const t=econTill(id),amt=Math.floor(t);if(amt<1)return silent?0:toast('הקופה ריקה עדיין');

function econRank(pid){const xp=econProState().xp[pid]||0;let r=1;for(let i=1;i<ECON_RANK_XP.length;i++)if(xp>=ECON_RANK_XP[i])r=i+1;return r}

function econMissionsOf(pid){return Object.values(MISSION_DEFS).filter(d=>econProOf(d)?.id===pid&&(d.reward||0)>0&&!(typeof d5MissionHidden==='function'&&d5MissionHidden(d.id)))}

 /* ---------- the tick ---------- */
 function step(){const b=B(),now=gm(),ss=storySteps(),F=g77St().flags;
  /* (1) out: done, or not valid any more (a lock, a licence, a job that is gone) */
  b.side=b.side.filter(q=>{const I=info(q.key);if(!I)return false;if(q.kind==='z'){if(I.done){b.n.done=(b.n.done||0)+1;log('done',q.key);return false}return I.run||zoneOk(q.id)}
   if(E.jobsDone.includes(q.id)){b.n.done=(b.n.done||0)+1;b.drop[q.key]=now+T.dropCool;log('done',q.key);return false}return I.run||jobOk(q.id,true)});E.jobsDone.length=0;
  /* (2) in: what the player started himself (F at the place / the list of the jobs) */
  for(const id of Object.keys(S9STORY.ST)){if(ss.z.has(id)||S9STORY.done(id)||!((S9STORY.step(id)||0)>0)||has(b,'z:'+id))continue;put(b,{key:'z:'+id,kind:'z',id,at:now,acc:1,src:'player'});b.n.player=(b.n.player||0)+1;mine('z:'+id)}
  const A=PlayerProfile.activeMission;if(A&&A.id&&!A.qa&&MISSION_DEFS[A.id]&&!/^M-ST-/.test(A.id)&&!ss.j.has(A.id)&&!has(b,'j:'+A.id)&&!zsJob(A.id)){put(b,{key:'j:'+A.id,kind:'j',id:A.id,at:now,acc:1,src:'player'});b.n.player=(b.n.player||0)+1;mine('j:'+A.id)}
  /* (2א) an old save with more than 6 stories that started by their hour: the ones that only got their first message go back (the progress of the others stays) */
  if(running(b)>LIM.sideMax){for(const q of b.side.slice().reverse()){if(running(b)<=LIM.sideMax)break;if(q.kind!=='z'||(S9STORY.step(q.id)||0)!==1||q.src!=='player')continue;F['s9:'+q.id]=0;try{const s=g77St();s.journal=s.journal.filter(j=>j.id!==q.id)}catch(e){}
   b.side=b.side.filter(x=>x!==q);b.drop[q.key]=now+T.evictCool;E.parked++;log('park',q.key)}}
  /* (3) the floor: fewer than 4 → new ones now */
  if(b.side.length<LIM.sideMin){const C=pool(b,now,LIM.sideMin-b.side.length).slice(0,LIM.sideMin-b.side.length);for(const c of C){put(b,{key:c.key,kind:c.kind,id:c.id,at:now,acc:0,src:'fill'});b.n.fill=(b.n.fill||0)+1;announce(c,'fill')}}
  /* (4) one offer at most, when there is room (5–6) */
  if(b.offer&&(has(b,b.offer.key)||now-b.offer.at>T.offerLife||!validNew(b.offer.key))){if(!has(b,b.offer.key))b.drop[b.offer.key]=now+T.dropCool;b.offer=null}
  if(!b.offer&&b.side.length>=LIM.sideMin&&b.side.length<LIM.sideMax&&now-(b.t||-1e9)>=T.offerGap){const c=pool(b,now)[0];b.t=now;if(c){b.offer={key:c.key,kind:c.kind,id:c.id,at:now};b.n.offer=(b.n.offer||0)+1;announce(c,'offer')}}
  /* (5) "קבל" from a call */
  if(F['mb:acc']){const k=F['mb:acc'];delete F['mb:acc'];act('acc',k)}
  /* (5א) a mission of the story that opened now — its card (once); the story counts 1–3 (074ze: MAXOPEN) */
  {const so=storyOpen(),seen=b.ss||(b.ss={});for(const q of so)if(!seen[q.id]){seen[q.id]=now;if(!quiet()){E.cardQ=E.cardQ.filter(x=>x.key!=='s:'+q.id);E.cardQ.push({key:'s:'+q.id,why:'story'})}}}
  /* (6) an accepted job: at its start — the card "להתחיל" (startMission, like the list) */
  if(!quiet()&&!PlayerProfile.activeMission){let a=null;try{a=playerActor()}catch(e){}for(const q of b.side){if(q.kind!=='j'||!q.acc)continue;const I=info(q.key);if(!I||!isFinite(I.x)||!a)continue;const d=Math.hypot(a.x-I.x,a.y-I.y);
   if(d<T.startR){if(!E.prompt[q.key]){E.prompt[q.key]=1;E.cardQ=E.cardQ.filter(x=>x.key!==q.key);E.cardQ.unshift({key:q.key,why:'start'})}}else if(d>T.startR*1.6)delete E.prompt[q.key]}}
  showCard()}
